title: Anchored degenerating profiles have a positive leading gap

sign_classification.nonnegative_profile_coercivity: The pointwise K1663 inequality includes t=0 and combines with K1661 to give C_(F,N)+gD_(M,N)>=eta^2 N B_N m_g for fixed m_g>0.
sign_classification.anchor_mass: The anchor hypothesis gives B_N=sum rho_k^2>=rho_-^2 q_N=Theta(N^3).
sign_classification.posterior_remainder: K1667 removes only O(N^3), leaving Q_N-lambda_N^statG>=c_(g,eta,rho_-,alpha,epsilon)N^4 for all sufficiently large N.
sign_classification.advance: A global positive profile floor is unnecessary: one fixed macroscopic observable anchor suffices even if every remaining amplitude vanishes or degenerates.
sign_classification.scope_guard: The theorem does not cover extensive anchor-free supports, unknown profiles, growing latent dimension, non-orbit laws or unrestricted Fisher/defect coercivity.
